usage: 蒜蓉菜心 is used primarily as a dish name in restaurants, emphasizing the presence of garlic sauce.
It functions as a noun and is often the object in a sentence when ordering food.
蒜蓉菜心 can appear in menus as a standalone phrase or as part of a list of vegetable dishes.
You can use the word to ask questions about preferred dishes or to express your food choices.
When speaking, it's common to emphasize the 蒜蓉 (garlic sauce) component to highlight the flavor.
